beijing.description: Ancient capital with imperial palaces and modern architecture

attractions.name: Forbidden City
attractions.highlight: Largest imperial palace complex in the world

attractions.name: Great Wall
attractions.highlight: Ancient fortification spanning thousands of miles

attractions.name: Summer Palace
attractions.highlight: Royal garden with Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill

attractions.name: Temple of Heaven
attractions.highlight: Ming Dynasty circular temple complex

attractions.name: 798 Art Zone
attractions.highlight: Contemporary art district in former factory complex

shanghai.description: Global financial hub blending East and West along the Huangpu River

attractions.name: The Bund
attractions.highlight: Iconic waterfront skyline and colonial architecture

attractions.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
attractions.highlight: Futuristic TV tower with glass observation deck

attractions.name: Yu Garden
attractions.highlight: Classical Ming Dynasty garden with rockeries and ponds

attractions.name: Nanjing Road
attractions.highlight: China's premier shopping street spanning 5.5 km

attractions.name: Shanghai Museum
attractions.highlight: Ancient Chinese art and bronze collections

chengdu.description: Laid-back city famous for spicy cuisine and giant pandas

attractions.name: Giant Panda Base
attractions.highlight: Research and breeding center for giant pandas

attractions.name: Jinli Ancient Street
attractions.highlight: Traditional Sichuan architecture with street food

attractions.name: Wuhou Shrine
attractions.highlight: Memorial temple of Three Kingdoms period

attractions.name: Mount Qingcheng
attractions.highlight: Taoist mountain with ancient temples and trails

attractions.name: Kuanzhai Alley
attractions.highlight: Restored Qing Dynasty courtyard neighborhood

xian.description: Ancient capital at the eastern terminus of the Silk Road

attractions.name: Terracotta Army
attractions.highlight: Thousands of life-sized warrior statues from 210 BC

attractions.name: City Wall
attractions.highlight: Best-preserved ancient city wall in China

attractions.name: Muslim Quarter
attractions.highlight: Vibrant food street with Hui Muslim cuisine

attractions.name: Big Wild Goose Pagoda
attractions.highlight: Tang Dynasty Buddhist pagoda from 652 AD

attractions.name: Shaanxi Museum
attractions.highlight: One of China's top history museums

hangzhou.description: Picturesque lakeside city celebrated in Chinese poetry for centuries

attractions.name: West Lake
attractions.highlight: UNESCO World Heritage lake surrounded by temples and gardens

attractions.name: Lingyin Temple
attractions.highlight: One of China's largest and wealthiest Buddhist temples

attractions.name: Longjing Tea Village
attractions.highlight: Home of the famous Dragon Well green tea

attractions.name: Leifeng Pagoda
attractions.highlight: Iconic lakeside pagoda with panoramic views

attractions.name: Xixi Wetland Park
attractions.highlight: Natural wetland with boat rides and bird watching

guilin.description: Karst mountain landscape renowned as China's most scenic destination

attractions.name: Li River
attractions.highlight: Iconic river cruise through limestone peaks

attractions.name: Reed Flute Cave
attractions.highlight: Spectacular karst cave with colorful lighting

attractions.name: Elephant Trunk Hill
attractions.highlight: Natural rock arch shaped like an elephant drinking

attractions.name: Longji Rice Terraces
attractions.highlight: Dragon's Backbone cascading terraced fields

attractions.name: Yangshuo West Street
attractions.highlight: Ancient street with cafes, bars and outdoor activities

tokyo.description: Tokyo is Japan’s dynamic capital, blending historic temples and neighborhoods with world-class shopping, food, and modern skyline views.

attractions.name: Senso-ji Temple (Asakusa)
attractions.highlight: Tokyo’s oldest temple, reached via the bustling Nakamise-dori shopping street.

attractions.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
attractions.hours: Varies by season (generally sunrise to sunset)
attractions.highlight: A tranquil Shinto shrine set in a large forested park near Harajuku.

attractions.name: Tokyo Skytree
attractions.ticket: From about ¥2,100 (Tembo Deck); higher for combo tickets
attractions.highlight: Panoramic city views from one of the world’s tallest towers.

attractions.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
attractions.hours: 9:00-16:30 (last entry 16:00); closed Mondays (or next weekday if Monday is a holiday)
attractions.highlight: Spacious landscaped gardens famous for seasonal cherry blossoms and autumn colors.

attractions.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
attractions.hours: Typically 5:00-14:00 (varies by shop); many closed Sundays/holidays
attractions.highlight: A lively market area known for fresh seafood, street food, and kitchenware shops.

nanjing.description: Nanjing is a historic former capital of China on the Yangtze River, known for major imperial-era landmarks, museums, and scenic lakeside parks.

attractions.name: Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum (明孝陵)
attractions.highlight: UNESCO-listed Ming dynasty imperial tomb with the famous Spirit Way stone statues.

attractions.name: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum (中山陵)
attractions.highlight: Grand hillside memorial with long ceremonial stairway honoring Sun Yat-sen.

attractions.name: Nanjing City Wall (中华门城堡 / Ming City Wall)
attractions.highlight: One of China’s best-preserved Ming-era fortifications, especially impressive at Zhonghua Gate.

attractions.name: Nanjing Museum (南京博物院)
attractions.highlight: Major national museum with extensive collections spanning prehistoric to modern China.

attractions.name: Xuanwu Lake Park (玄武湖公园)
attractions.highlight: Large urban lake with scenic causeways and views of the city wall and Jiming Temple.

paris.description: Paris is France’s capital, celebrated for its art, architecture, cuisine, and iconic landmarks along the Seine.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.highlight: Panoramic city views from the summit and upper platforms.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum
attractions.highlight: Home to the Mona Lisa and one of the world’s largest art collections.

attractions.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral (Parvis and exterior)
attractions.highlight: Gothic architecture on Île de la Cité; admire the façade and riverside views.

attractions.name: Musée d'Orsay
attractions.highlight: Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterpieces in a former railway station.

attractions.name: Champs-Élysées & Arc de Triomphe
attractions.highlight: Stroll Paris’s famous avenue and climb the Arc for views over the city’s grand axes.

seoul.description: Dynamic capital blending ancient palaces with cutting-edge technology

attractions.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
attractions.highlight: Largest of Five Grand Palaces from Joseon Dynasty

attractions.name: N Seoul Tower
attractions.highlight: Panoramic city views from Namsan Mountain

attractions.name: Myeongdong
attractions.highlight: K-beauty and street food paradise

attractions.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
attractions.highlight: Traditional Korean houses dating back 600 years

attractions.name: Hongdae
attractions.highlight: Youth culture hub with live music and art
